methods.what: Continued-fraction expansion of 8/13 with its convergents
Rule assigning the term $(2\alpha\pm1)\pi i$ when passing from $n'/n$ to the mediants $(n'\mp m')/(n\mp m)$
General linear-fractional parametrisation between consecutive convergents with associated term $(2\alpha\pm x)\pi i$
Congruence condition mod 4 and parity conditions on numerators/denominators

methods.quote: $\delta\Omega = 2\int\int\left[\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\frac{\partial\delta u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\frac{\partial\delta u}{\partial y}\right]dx\,dy$
